latest_cos_commentary.headline: Entegra, a Sodexo-owned restaurant GPO, is expanding internationally via its 2026 acquisition of UK procurement firm Prestige Purchasing.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: No direct overlap with Genius's pos/payments/kitchen_drive_thru/loyalty_engagement/digital_menu_boards lines; at most tangentially adjacent to back_office cost-management if a restaurant compares software spend against overall procurement savings.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Entegra is actively consolidating the hospitality procurement/GPO space via acquisition (Prestige Purchasing, 2026), expanding its addressable footprint in UK hospitality.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Not a competitive-displacement conversation for POS/payments; relevant only if a prospect frames technology spend as part of a broader procurement/GPO relationship with Entegra/Sodexo.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: No current named leadership or specific restaurant customer names were found in this pass; savings claims are vendor-stated.
